summary: Tested 3 new additive features on top of a stable app: (1) fair 18-hole-equivalent scoring average, (2) home-course toggle button, (3) location-first course search sorting. All 11 new backend pytest cases pass. Frontend flows verified end-to-end via browser automation: profile AVG=81 (extrapolated, matches expected (82+79+82)/3), Courses Played list shows Pebble Beach Golf Course Best 82/Avg 82 (extrapolated from raw 41-on-9-holes), HomeCourseButton toggles correctly ('Set as home course' <-> 'Home course') alongside WishlistButton with no layout collision, and Discover tab shows a 'Home course' badge on exactly the matching course row and no others. Light regression on wishlist add/check and course detail endpoint also passed.
critical_code_review_comments: helpers.extrapolate_18_score and batch_course_par_cache are clean, well-documented pure functions, correctly reused by both get_user (recent 20 rounds) and get_courses_played (all rounds per course) — no duplication.
HomeCourseButton.tsx mirrors WishlistButton's UX pattern well (optimistic PATCH /auth/me + setUser); silently swallows errors on failure by design, which is acceptable for this low-stakes toggle.

courses.py discover_courses/course_search location-first sort correctly falls back to popularity/name-only sort when lat/lng are absent (verified no exceptions and no regression on plain name search).

Minor observation (not a bug, out of scope per review request): discover_courses' per-course 'avg_score'/'best_score' fields (shown in the Discover course-row subtitle, e.g. 'Avg 41 · Best 41' for Pebble Beach in the UI) are still raw/un-extrapolated across all users at that course — only the per-viewing-user endpoints (get_user, get_courses_played) were required to extrapolate per this session's scope, so this is not a defect against the stated requirements, but could look inconsistent to a user who just saw their own profile show an extrapolated 82 for the same course. Flagging for awareness only.
seed_data_creation: None persisted; home_course was set then cleared back to empty during testing; wishlist test entry (Cypress Ridge) added then removed via cleanup calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (fair 18-hole scoring average, home course toggle, location-first sort) fully verified at both backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright/browser automation) level with 0 bugs found. reese's expected avg=81.0 and Pebble Beach course avg/best=82.0/82 confirmed via API and UI. Regression spot-checks (wishlist, course detail) also pass. No blocking issues; this session's scope is complete.
